name: QubitSense
one_liner: Quantum magnetometers that find corrosion inside pipelines without digging them up.
product: A drone- and pig-mounted NV-diamond magnetometer plus a cloud model that flags wall loss in buried steel pipelines; inspection reports delivered per kilometre surveyed.
target_customers: Integrity managers at midstream oil and gas operators and municipal water utilities in North America
pricing_today: One paid pilot at $40k for 25 km
traction: 1 paid pilot with a Texas midstream operator; 2 utilities in LOI talks
team: CEO (ex-pipeline integrity engineer), CTO (PhD quantum sensing), 4 engineers
goals_90d: Convert the pilot into an annual contract and sign 2 more pilots
constraints: Field crews are scarce; regulatory acceptance (PHMSA) of the method is pending
